answer: Bind each account to a hardware attestation key. At signup the agent signs a beacon nonce with a TPM or secure-enclave key, and the network admits one account per device per 30 epochs. A 1,000-puppet farm needs 1,000 real chips, about $150,000 at $150 each, and revoking one device key drops every account it signed. A VM can't produce the vendor certificate chain. The fable of free keys ends: an onyx rack of mini PCs wired in a spiral is costly, visible hardware.
